step1_analysis.description: This circuit acts as a gated current mirror that charges an output node (N3) to VDD when both inputs (N1, OUT) are high. It is likely part of the reference voltage generator or charge pump control logic for the flash memory, providing a controlled pull-up current.

paper_reference.title: A 126.6-mm2 AND-Type 512-Mb Flash Memory With 1.8-V Power Supply

Operating_Voltage.description: Supply voltage for the low-voltage control logic

sky130_expected.calculation: Given by the testbench setup and paper specifications.
sky130_expected.reasoning: Standard 1.8V supply for SKY130 and matching the paper's low-voltage operation.
Based on the saturation current of the PMOS mirror and NMOS pull-down network when active.

Output_High_Voltage_N3.description: Maximum voltage reached at the output node N3

sky130_expected.calculation: XM5 pulls N3 to VDD. With a 100k test load, it reaches near 1.8V.
sky130_expected.reasoning: The PMOS strongly pulls the node to VDD when the mirror is active.

Propagation_Delay.description: Delay from N1 rising to N3 rising

sky130_expected.reasoning: Fast charging due to the strong PMOS mirror and small parasitic capacitance at N3.

step3_testbench.description: Testbench to measure the DC and transient characteristics of the gated current mirror. A load resistor is added to N3 to prevent floating nodes and allow discharge when the mirror is off.
step3_testbench.spice:
* Testbench for Gated Current Mirror
.lib "${SKY130_PDK}" tt

.param W_xm1=5u L_xm1=0.5u
.param W_xm2=5u L_xm2=0.5u
.param W_xm3=5u L_xm3=0.5u
.param W_xm4=5u L_xm4=0.5u
.param W_xm5=5u L_xm5=0.5u
.param W_xm6=5u L_xm6=0.5u

XM1 N4 OUT N2 GND sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l={L_xm1} w={W_xm1}
XM2 N2 N1 GND GND sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l={L_xm2} w={W_xm2}
XM3 VDD N3 VDD VDD sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l={L_xm3} w={W_xm3}
XM4 N3 N1 N1 GND sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l={L_xm4} w={W_xm4}
XM5 N3 N4 VDD VDD sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l={L_xm5} w={W_xm5}
XM6 N4 N4 VDD VDD sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l={L_xm6} w={W_xm6}

VVDD VDD 0 1.8
V_N1 N1 0 DC 1.8 PULSE(0 1.8 5n 0.1n 0.1n 10n 20n)
V_OUT OUT 0 DC 1.8

* Load to prevent floating and allow discharge
Rload N3 0 100k
Cload N3 0 10f

.control
tran 0.1n 40n
meas tran avg_power avg (-i(VVDD)*1.8)
meas tran v_n4_min min v(N4)
meas tran v_n3_max max v(N3)
meas tran t_rise_n3 trig v(N1) val=0.9 rise=1 targ v(N3) val=0.9 rise=1
meas tran t_fall_n4 trig v(N1) val=0.9 rise=1 targ v(N4) val=0.9 fall=1

dc V_N1 0 1.8 0.05
meas dc v_n4_active find v(N4) when v(N1)=1.8
meas dc v_n3_active find v(N3) when v(N1)=1.8

quit
.endc
.end
